problem:
An irrigation tank initially holds $800\,\text{L}$ of water containing $1\,200\,\text{g}$ of dissolved fertilizer.
A solution containing $25\,\text{g/L}$ of dissolved fertilizer is pumped into the tank at a rate of $6\,\text{L/min},$ while the completely mixed water is drained out at a rate of $10\,\text{L/min}.$ Which differential equation best describes the amount of fertilizer $Q$ in the tank $t$ minutes after pumping begins?

Question 4
?

An irrigation tank initially holds 800L of water containing 1200g of dissolved fertilizer. A solution containing 25g/L of dissolved fertilizer is pumped into the tank at a rate of 6L/min, while the completely mixed water is drained out at a rate of 10L/min. Which differential equation best describes the amount of fertilizer Q in the tank t minutes after pumping begins?

a
dQdt+6800−4tQ=150
b
dQdt+10800−4tQ=25
c
dQdt−6800−4tQ=150
d
dQdt+10800−4tQ=150
e
dQdt−10800−4tQ=150
Submit
